programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now a dilemma arises. Mr. Dickenson has to make the final decision and he's leaning toward calling it a tie because he's afraid that if they continue the battle, someone could get hurt. But Kai steps up to the plate and pleads his case for the battle to continue, which it does! As the fight resumes, the intensity is felt throughout the arena. Again they are evenly matched and it looks like no one will take it, when' they both mount a final assault! It's huge! In the end, Tyson comes out on top and Daichi and Tyson become the new Beyblade Tag Team World Champions!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi win the Beyblade Tag Team World Championship but Daichi is jealous that Tyson is getting all the attention. He decides the only way he can get the respect he deserves is to go on a training mission and come back and defeat Tyson on his own. He hitches a ride on a truck and falls asleep but wakes up far away from home, alone and hungry. Luckily he runs into Max and his father who invite him back to their house for dinner. During the meal Max squirts mustard on Daichi's steak telling him it will make it taste better. This disgusts Daichi, and in his anger he insults Max and his father. Max takes offense and challenges Daichi to a Beyblade battle. The match is a close one and Daichi is confident he can beat Max but he was beaten by Max's strength. He decides that the only way he can become a better Blader is to start training with Max. Meanwhile Tyson discovers Daichi gone and wonders why and where his Blading partner has gone.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A news bulletin announces that the BBA has been bought and transformed into a new, professional league, named the BEGA League and that Mr. Dickenson has resigned from his position as Chairman. The kids go off in search of their old friend and demand an explanation. Ashamed, Mr. Dickenson reveals that the board of the BBA had completed the plans to sell the league while he was occupied with the World Championships. Tyson resolves to show up at the press conference the next day and discover who is behind the plot. But at the press conference, he is faced with the new singing sensation, Ming-Ming who announces that not only is she the official mascot of the BEGA League but also its top ranked professional Beyblader. Tyson challenges her to Beybattle and Ming-Ming accepts under the condition that Tyson beat her entire Ming-Ming Band. Will Tyson, Max and Daichi be able to beat the Beybattling band and face off against an old foe?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max, Kenny and Daichi are invited by Boris to take a tour inside his new BEGA headquarters. Hilary isn't allowed inside until the official public opening, and is sent away, much to her chagrin. The boys find that the BEGA building is unparalleled in the quality of its Beyblade training and facilities. Impressive as it is however, Tyson is still highly distrustful of Boris, who was responsible for trying to take over the world two years ago by using his team the Demolition Boys as soldiers. Boris tries to convince Tyson that he's changed. Ever since his scheme was uncovered, he roamed throughout his homeland doing some soul searching. There, while watching some village children Beyblade, he had an epiphany. He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days earlier he lost a battle to Brooklyn. So, wanting to save face, Kai calls out Brooklyn, who arrogantly accepts his challenge. A massive battle ensues with Kai trying desperately to somehow attack his opponent, but nothing seems to work. And what's worse, Brooklyn seems to be copying Kai's every move. Kai becomes frustrated and realizes he must dig deep within himself to draw out more power. He does, however, it's making him weaker and weaker. The rest of the G Revolutions team wants him to quit. Kai refuses and in the end, he prepares for a final assault against his foe!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid's next target is Green Dream, the world's largest emerald and a one-time-only stage prop for a local play. Though the venue is crawling with cops under Nakamori's command, will Kid be able to make off with Green Dream as well as make a young actress's dream come true?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]

programme.desc: Emiliano está destrozado por la noticia que recibió sobre la condena de su amigo Felipe. Rosario y Fernando continúan esperándolo en el bar. Mientras tanto, el Coloso delata a Emiliano con don Carlos y este le pone un ultimátum.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los mariachis le dan serenata a una pareja homosexual sin estar al tanto y por esto el coloso arma un gran escándalo. Por otro lado, Martin no puede combatir su sentido de culpa y le escribe a Emiliano diciéndole que puede ayudarlo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Martin le comunica a Emiliano que va viajar a Colombia para hablar con él y ayudarlo. Por otro lado, Emiliano enfurece al ver que Javier Macías está recogiendo a Rosario en la universidad.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano le reclama a Javier por usar la deuda que tiene Rosario con él para aprovecharse de ella. Por otro lado, a pesar de las diferencias, Emiliano decide salvar al Coloso de ser descubierto en la cama con una mujer casada.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Virginia encuentra la forma de fastidiar a Emiliano haciéndolo quedar mal con Rosario. En el bar Garibaldi habrá un encuentro de rancheras entre Emiliano y Rosario, un grupo de mujeres despechadas apoyaran a Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Virginia habla con Rosario para confundirla aún más. Cuatro mujeres que se encuentran en el bar se han solidarizado con Rosario por su gran despecho y la han invitado a tomar con ellas. .

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: En medio de su borrachera, las mujeres despechadas y Rosario, convertirán en cenizas todas las pertenencias del ex marido de una de ellas. Rosario ha humillado a Emiliano y ahora deberá buscar la forma de reivindicarse con él.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Después de varios meses de conquista, discusiones, engaños y perdón, Emiliano y Rosario se entregan en cuerpo y alma uno al otro. Por otro lado, Fernando prepara todo para la llegada de Martin Del Valle a Colombia.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Martin llega a Bogotá y se aloja en el hotel asignado por Fernando. Por otro lado, todos en el bar se llevan una gran sorpresa al ver que Rosario y Emiliano se han reconciliado. El coloso pierde el control y enfrenta a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Qué bonito amor. Emiliano y Rosario disfrutan de su segunda noche juntos. Mientras tanto, Raquel espera impaciente a Rosario en casa. Por otro lado, Leticia es atracada en la calle y debe recurrir a Fernando para que la ayude.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Todo está listo para el encuentro entre Emiliano y Martin. Emiliano quedará derrumbado y perderá el control al conocer toda la verdad a boca de su cuñado. Emiliano le dará indicaciones a Martin para poder arreglar la situación en la que está.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un sospechoso atado a una silla se porta de mal a peor. Un preso con cubreboca-antiescupir pide suplementos. A un preso le gusta la oficial. Un vagabundo quería lo suyo de la casa de su ex-esposa.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: No prender un porro cerca del crimen es la lección. Un oficial aconseja a una pareja joven drogadicta. Se le acaba la suerte a una prostituta con tutú. Los oficiales recogen a un niño por la 93ª vez.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer pelea con otra porque la ve fijamente. Arrestan a alguien porque al pelear quebró el vidrio de un hotel. Un cantante cree que los de música-rap lo rescatarán. Una mujer esposada coquetea.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Hombre cree ser un extraterrestre arrestado injustamente. Estudiante de derecho no entiende por qué fue arrestado. Mujer se tragó las pastillas de su amiga. Esposo termina moreteado y ensangrentado.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: La noche que Mayweather y Pacquiao pelean una mujer golpea al de seguridad. Un hombre que afirma haber servido en el ejército reta y amenaza. Un aficionado de "Pac-man" discute con su esposa.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Aíslan a un preso que tomó mucha cafeína. Un hombre arrestado por manejar tomado dice que le robaron. Un peatón cruzó la calle ilegalmente y según alguien lo golpeó. Un preso le da un puñetazo a otro.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: 45 veces detenida, pero tiene consejos para un drogadicto. Un juego de pies resulta en cárcel para dos hermanos australianos. Un guardia borracho de un club nocturno destruye su escúter.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer ebria aprende que portarse bien vale la pena. Una prostituta experta le ruega a una jovencita que se salga del “juego”. Una mujer enojada rompe el parabrisas de su novio infiel.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Vagabundo golpea a alguien por un comentario racista. Hombre asalta con ladrillo a otro. Joven llora y afirma que fue arrestado falsamente. Luchador termina en el hospital y el cantinero en la cárcel.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Tres jovencitas fueron arrestadas por posesión de drogas en un festival de música. Hay drogas en una persona durante el ingreso. Un hombre mayor, en el festival de música, fue detenido por posesión.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una conductora con un bebé en el asiento trasero envía mensajes de texto, bebe y conduce. Tras ser detenido por robar en una tienda, un joven se da cuenta de las consecuencias de su delito.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre arrestado se enoja porque dejó comida en la parrilla; un hombre borracho coquetea con el personal de la cárcel; un recluso vende hojas de árbol como marihuana a un oficial encubierto.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un excéntrico habitual vuelve a la cárcel. Un hombre que huye de México detalla los horrores de los que escapó. Una mujer joven describe su lucrativa temporada como bailarina exótica

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer que se hace llamar la luz del sol tiene un carácter severa. Un hombre prefiere la cárcel a un centro de reinserción social. Un delincuente profesional no muestra ningún arrepentimiento.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un recluso afirma ser víctima de una estafa en internet que condujo a su arresto. Los agentes tratan con indulgencia a un recluso alborotador que atraviesa una crisis espiritual.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Dos hermanas se embarcan en una pequeña ola de delitos, son detenidas y descubren que nadie las sacará de la cárcel. Una discusión doméstica lleva a un marido a la cárcel por forzar su propio coche.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer agitada quiere tomar las decisiones. Un hombre borracho afirma que conoce la ley y un anciano es detenido por violencia doméstica.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer va a la cárcel tras decirle a la policía que se asustó por una máscara de mono. Un hombre ebrio se enamora de una agente. Un agente encuentra contrabando en un paquete de cigarrillos.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Durante un turno, los agentes se enfrentan con un recluso que se niega a cambiar de celda, y lidian con los caprichos de un hombre que exige servicio de habitaciones y una celda mejor.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un padre comete un robo desesperado para llegar a fin de mes. Un chantaje se vuelve mortal cuando los agentes descubren un contrabando alarmante. Una reclusa se hace la inocente.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un fideicomisario se encuentra en problemas cuando los oficiales descubren artículos ilícitos. Después de un robo, un trabajador petrolero no cree que el cargo se ajuste al delito.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre arrestado por violencia doméstica amenaza con encarcelar a todos los agentes. Los reclusos de servicio de cocina se pelean por un paño de cocina. Una mujer es arrestada por allanamiento.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer confiesa haber escondido drogas en un lugar donde no se pueden ver.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre detenido es captado por la cámara mientras intenta escapar.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: El alcohol y una disputa por un teléfono móvil llevan a un hombre al "traje verde."

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Los agentes advierten a un hombre que disfrazarse de payaso en Texas no es una buena idea.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Los agentes encuentran drogas durante un cacheo que da lugar a un tenso enfrentamiento. Un hombre golpea a un pitbull y termina en la cárcel, donde se encuentra con un héroe de la infancia.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Enojada por su arresto, una mujer se vuelve combativa con los oficiales. Arrestada nuevamente por drogas, una joven inteligente sabe que está tomando malas decisiones, pero no puede dejar de consumir.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Los agentes tienen que intervenir cuando un hombre intenta tragarse su anillo. Un adicto a la heroína busca ayuda cuando se da cuenta de que su adicción le ha costado todo lo que ama.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Ponen a un hombre rencoroso y agresivo en una silla de sujeción. Una mujer ebria recibe una nota de amor de parte de un hombre encarcelado con permiso de trabajo.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre acude a la violencia cuando lo detienen por estar en lugar prohibido. Una mujer de la noche confesa que le oculta a sus clientes que tiene pediculosis. Una mujer explica que sus tatuajes son recuerdos de las mujeres que amó.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se ordena un registro corporal al desnudo y se descubre a un hombre con ropa interior femenina. Un par de roba-cachorros se tratan amorosamente en el baño. Una mujer embarazada es arrestada por prostitución.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: El capellán de la prisión aconseja a un preso triste. Una mujer ebria exige hablar con la Embajada de Canadá.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Cambian a un hombre peleonero a otra celda. Una mujer transgénero comparte su historia. Un automovilista manejando alocadamente se detiene, y un hombre intoxicado se arresta por agresividad.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre arrestado les canta a los oficiales. Una mujer es acusada de robo. Los oficiales no se dejan engañar por las lágrimas fingidas de una mujer joven.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre es acusado de posesión de una sustancia ilegal. La policía arresta a una mujer con narcóticos y atrapa a una pareja con receta médica falsa.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se acusa a una mujer de posesión de narcóticos. Una mujer niega haber agredido a su esposo y dos primos agresivos amenazan a la policía y terminan en aislamiento.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un preso no causa gracia con sus payasadas. Una mujer presume sobresalir en la prueba de conducción bajo los efectos del alcohol. Un hombre manejando bajo los efectos del alcohol causa la muerte de un hombre.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Dos presos alborotados terminan en sujeción. Un presunto ladrón se preocupa por una alergia a la leche. Una prisionera se enoja por el cuidado que se les da a sus pertenencias.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer es detenida por atacar a su novio. Un preso que habla mucho es trasladado al aislamiento. Un preso atrevido pelea contra la sujeción e intenta escapar de sus ataduras.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se descubre que una mujer tiene agujas y que otra tiene una pistola de descarga eléctrica. Una prueba de conducción bajo los efectos del alcohol causa malos recuerdos para un hombre que conduce en estado de ebriedad. Un asesino convicto actúa violentamente.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se alega que un pasajero agredió a el taxista. Una mujer describe como agredió a su novio con comida caliente. Se arresta a una madre que dejó a sus hijos en el automóvil mientras ella jugaba a las apuestas.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer intenta ocultar sustancias ilegales en su sostén. Unos compañeros de banda reciben una infracción por andar en propiedad prohibida. Después de perder el control, separan y sujetan a dos presos.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un preso restringido e intoxicado logra desatarse. Una joven niega haber abusado de su madre. Un guardia saca a un preso que está causando disturbios.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre indigente intenta resistirse de los oficiales cuando lo llevan a la cárcel, pero después les canta una canción. Un preso dificultoso culpa a varias condiciones médicas por su comportamiento. Una mujer dice que ella es Jesucristo.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer se niega a usar el uniforme de la cárcel. Un hombre cuenta su conmovedora historia a los oficiales, y una mujer ebria que habla mucho se pone en aislamiento.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Sujetan a unos presos escandalosos después de empezar pleitos. Una mujer lucha contra el abuso de sustancias tras la muerte de su prometido. Dos “mujeres de la noche” jóvenes platican de sus estrategias cuando van de casino en casino.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre se preocupa de más por su reloj de $30,000, y después llora cuando le sacan sangre. Una mujer ebria amenaza a los oficiales que la arrestaron con violencia corporal. Una mujer no recuerda cuando la arrestaron.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: El coqueteo de un prisionero calma una pelea en la cárcel. Un hombre ebrio intenta evitar las consecuencias por manejar tomado por octava vez, alegando que le robaron el auto. Una pareja termina en la cárcel por un desacuerdo a causa del Facebook.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una noche de karaoke resulta en un cargo de violencia doméstica. Un preso borracho comienza una pelea con su compañero de celda.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer rehúsa a obedecer cuando es tiempo de ingresar a la cárcel. Una mujer-gato es arrestada por golpear a su pareja en un club. Un hombre que vende drogas habla sobre sus contribuciones a la economía.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Hay coraje y mal genio cuando dos prisioneros comparten una celda. Una mujer ebria les hace pasar un mal rato a los oficiales. Un estafador detenido por manejar tomado quiere cambiar y mejorar.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Unas prostitutas hablan cándidamente sobre su ocupación y explican el sistema de cobrar. Una mujer intoxicada no quiere que le extraigan sangre. Dos supuestos ladrones enfrentan las posibles consecuencias de sus acciones.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre admite haber orinado en público. Una cita amorosa termina en cita en la cárcel. Se sospecha que un hombre maneja tomado y se desmaya durante el ingreso a la cárcel.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre intoxicado cree que los médicos son de la CIA, agentes de espionaje. Las acciones de un karateca indigente se castigan con aislamiento en una celda. Un hombre canadiense sin pantalones quiere jugar a las vencidas.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se descubre un alijo secreto cuando se revisa la propiedad de un sospechoso. Dos prisioneros escándalos terminan no llevándose bien por no respetarse el uno al otro. Se le siguen cayendo los pantalones a un peatón cruzando a media calle.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se acusa a una “mujer de la noche” cara de no pagar la cuenta por viajar en limosina. Un mujeriego insulta y dice obscenidades a la enfermera de la cárcel. Una prostituta con mucha experiencia considera empezar un negocio de juguetes sexuales.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un prisionero se vuelve agresivo cuando lo revisan durante una inspección común in corriente. Un anciano confundido piensa que el centro de detención es el sitio de un concurso de poesía. Dos novias se pelean mientras apuestan.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: La novia mal entraña de un narcotraficante termina aislada. La policía atiende a un problema con un hombre ebrio acusado de tirar piedras. Los guardias tratan de calmar un pleito entre compañeros de celda.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Arrestan a una dominatriz que se le pasa la mano de agresión mientras “jugaba.” Un padre es acusado de agredir al novio de su hija. El mal genio de un prisionero causa problemas.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un prisionero interrumpe el proceso de ingreso a la cárcel. La violencia domestica entre una pareja es evidente, pero ellos la niegan y dicen que en realidad era intimidad. Una mujer encarcelada con cámara escondida comparte los videos intrusivos.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Los guardias descubren objetos para el aseo personal escondidos en un lugar raro al revisar las pertenencias de una mujer. Un turista encarcelado amenaza con traer a Johnny Cochran como abogado para su defensa. Un conductor ebrio se despierta y encuentra una obra de arte pornográfica dibujada en su cuerpo.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un preso se traga un alijo de drogas y luego le vienen las ganas de comer. Un hombre de 72 años da pretextos raros para explicar porque les vende drogas a adolescentes en un centro comercial. Una mujer acusada de agredir al dueño de la propiedad finge estar enferma para salir de la cárcel.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una prostituta se arresta en un día de trabajo lento. Un prisionero ebrio se mete con los guardias. Una mujer enojada le dice malas palabras a un guardia.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un mujeriego obtiene ropa interior de mujer en la cárcel. Una mujer que se detenida por un accidente automovilístico descubre incrédulamente que fumar marihuana mientras conduciendo es ilegal. Un joven acusado de manejar tomado les dice a los guardias que teme quedar embarazado tras las rejas.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre ebrio declara ser parte del movimiento “Ocupar Wall Street,” protesta contra la desigualdad económica. Los oficiales luchan contra un hombre violento. Un ladrón de dulces llora cuando es detenido.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre entrenado en las artes marciales intenta zafarse de las esposas y se atora más. Una rivalidad de fútbol-estadounidense termina mal cuando un aficionado de los Steelers ataca a un uno de los Ravens.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una pareja es arrestada por obscenidad enseñando más de lo que debe. Una mujer ebria acusa que la tratan injustamente. Un hombre con un historial criminal es arrestado.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un prisionero que no coopera complica la situación. Un hombre acusado de manejar tomado se queja de la comida de la prisión. Una guardia de seguridad doméstica nacional que fue arrestada por robo teme que el trabajo de sus sueños de seguridad nacional ha terminado.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer que fue detenida por cruzar a media calle afirma que la policía se pasó de la raya por arrestarla. Una mujer es acusada de violencia doméstica. Un traficante de drogas declara que las vende para alivianar su deuda y adicción y al póquer.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer que acosa a David Copperfield es arrestada. Una prisionera ebria se queja de los guardias. Un hombre que es detenido por andar manejando afectado por medicamentos aúlla a su perro.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un delincuente reincidente intenta provocar una pelea física con los oficiales. Una vaquera ebria arma un escándalo porque le quitan las botas. Más tarde, un hombre recogido por portar un arma oculta declara que la navaja en realidad es para abrir ostras.

programme.title: Jail en Español

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: She was the heaviest woman in the world, tipping the scales at over 1100 pounds … can a new bariatric surgery save her life? Then, the inspiring story of a Saved by The Bell star who started going blind at age 13 and now thinks it’s the best thing to ever happen to him! A breast cancer survivor turns to The Doctors after her reconstruction goes wrong! Can she be healed? And, one of our most infamous guests - “The Sperminator” – is back with baby news!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors teach you how to improve your health sunup to sundown! Find out how to eliminate not-so-fresh morning breath, avoid frustrating razor bumps and make sleepless nights a thing of the past.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, meet the father who had to have his hands and feet amputated after an extremely rare case of strep throat! Don’t miss the moment his family gets the surprise of a lifetime! Then, reality TV star and model Courtney Stodden reaches out to THE DOCTORS for help with depression and drugs and speaks out about her controversial marriage and rocky relationship with her mother! Plus, a doctor’s fight to save his brother’s life requires he become a donor! Then, a guest who was addicted to eating clay pots returns; has she kicked her strange habit for good?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Live fast, die young, party all night – rock and roll’s infamous lifestyle is in the spotlight. Learn how to stay safe while you have fun! Plus, the daughter of shock rocker Alice Cooper shares stories from life on the road.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Woman takes justice into her own hands and busts son-in-law who wanted to meet up with her for sex! Dad uses daughter as bait to catch a predator? The Doctors investigates vigilante justice! The Doctors Exclusive: Comedian Kym Whitley in the operating room for her double chin surgery! Decluttering tips from top home organizer. The practical takeaway to get your house back in order! Three great mayo swaps for a healthier lunch!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Milk, eggs, medicine and sneakers all have one thing in common: limited shelf lives. But do you really need to toss them by a certain date? THE DOCTORS reveal when something is safe to keep and when you should throw it away! Do you know what lurks in your mattress and linens? See the shocking results one couple receives, and learn how to keep your bed clean and safe. You don’t always need an expiration date to tell you when food has gone bad. Learn a simple trick to identify a good egg from a bad egg. And, leftovers don’t come with an “eat-by” date. THE DOCTORS explain when your leftovers should head to the trash can. Do you have a hard time parting with comfortable old shoes? Find out the shelf life for your sneakers, and see why you might want to toss out your old kicks.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: We go “inside the O.R.” for an amazing update as two identical twin sisters get the “twinning” facelifts they’ve always wanted! The RefrigerDATEr’s back to help another single bachelorette find a man – by looking through the contents of his refrigerator! Is viral “60 second rule” to a clearer face legit? Is the mental workload of running a house harming moms’ health?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Marriage, work, motherhood and stress can take a toll on your health, as well as your looks. Actress and author Lisa Rinna joins The Doctors to lend insight on how to get your sexy back, and look and feel your best at any age!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A cervical cancer test in the doctor's office is saving lives. See it performed live. And, Amanda lost 180 pounds, but excess skin and fat hung from her body. See The Total Body Lift surgery that allowed her to reclaim her life!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: What foods, products and procedures are right for you? Are artificial sweeteners safe? The Doctors Health Investigator, Liz Vaccariello, uncovers the truth! Plus, wellness tips for back-to-school.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Embarrassing conditions, annoying problem areas, unsightly body parts … everyone has at least one or two. But you don’t have to be stuck with them! Get solutions for painful heartburn, frequent urination, stuttering and more.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Runny noses, stuffy heads and aching bodies can only mean one thing: cold and flu season is in full swing. Find out 40 ways to fight the flu and outsmart a cold! Plus, the latest technology to keep your gadgets germ-free.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Is a simple seasoning the culprit for expanding waistlines? Most Americans consume two to three times the amount of salt necessary per day. The Nutrition Twins, registered dieticians, believe excess salt is largely to blame for America’s obesity epidemic. Learn their secret to staying skinny and try the diet designed to kick the salt habit for good! THE DOCTORS joins forces with Iams pet food to support Iams’ Home 4 the Holidays pet adoption program. Learn the health benefits of pets, for both humans and animals alike! A controversial court ruling in a worker’s compensation case may change the way employers hire. Will your weight jeopardize your job prospects? Plastic surgeon Dr. Drew Ordon demonstrates the latest wrinkle-relaxer on 35-year-old Jennifer. See the amazing after results! If you’re trying to lose weight, studies have shown that when you eat may be more important than what you eat. Snacking at the wrong time can increase your weight gain by 50 percent! Find out when to nibble and when to just say no. Pediatrician Dr. Jim Sears uncovers hidden choking dangers for toddlers and demonstrates what to do if your child’s airway is obstructed.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Embarrassing, Gross, and Wild Special brings you some of The Doctors’ most unforgettable moments! See “The Great Pop-Off”! Relive Dr. Pimple Popper’s biggest and best pops! Marvel at the courage of guests who shared Their most embarrassing problems to raise awareness! From the huge, painful keloids that isolated a school teacher to The severe birthmarks that tormented a young woman, These guests stepped out of the shadows for help. Don’t miss one man’s 315-pound transformation! Laugh and learn as Dr. Ordon and NBA star Jon Salley undergo prostate exams backstage! Score a simple fix for dry, chalky elbows.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A new “natural” filler is revealed LIVE on the show! A woman discovers her home has become a beehive and turns to THE DOCTORS for help! Would you choose to stay pregnant for 5 years to avoid maternity leave? THE DOCTORS tackles paid maternity leave. In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, a mom raises awareness about the rare disease turning her daughter into a “hulk baby” … and THE DOCTORS surprises her in ways she never saw coming! Climate control bedding is put to the test! And, are your kids at risk for kitchen burns? Are you making cleaning mistakes that could make you sick? Get the facts!

programme.title: The Doctors

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this unforgettable episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart of Istanbul—a city where East meets West, and ancient tradition blends seamlessly with modern life. From the vibrant Spice Bazaar filled with Turkish delight and tea, to Michelin-starred Ottoman cuisine that revives centuries-old royal recipes, Sandra dives deep into the flavors and culture of this mesmerizing destination. She explores the mysterious Basilica Cistern, a hidden underground marvel, and reveals the artistry behind handwoven Turkish carpets—each a story told in knots and color. With practical travel tips, immersive storytelling, and a few laughs along the way, this episode is both a guide and a love letter to one of the world’s most captivating cities. Whether you're drawn to history, food, shopping, or simply want to experience something magical, Istanbul delivers—and this episode shows you why it belongs on every traveler’s bucket list.

programme.title: Sicily With Aldo & Enzo
programme.desc: The secrets of Sicily's diverse culinary culture are revealed amid some of the most stunning Sicilian locations.

programme.title: Edible Nutmeg: On the Road
programme.desc: In this episode, we follow Chef Plum as he visits Gilbertie's Herb Garden in Easton, CT, to chat with owner Sal Gilbertie about his nursery where he tosses a delicious carrot and microgreen salad with fresh ricotta and a bacon-mustard vinaigrette.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode of Authentic Escapes, host Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart and soul of Budapest, Hungary’s enchanting capital. From panoramic views at Fisherman’s Bastion to the colorful stalls of Central Market Hall, she explores the city’s rich blend of history, food, and culture. Sandra soaks in centuries of tradition at the famous Gellért Thermal Baths, where locals come daily to relax in mineral-rich waters. She then dines at the legendary Gundel Restaurant, where Hungarian staples like goulash and Gundel pancakes are served with royal flair and historical significance. Between bites and baths, Sandra shares practical travel tips—how to ride the tram, when to cross the Danube for the best sunset views, and why you should book Parliament tickets in advance. Whether you're drawn to architecture, cuisine, or unforgettable experiences, this episode proves that Budapest is a city worth savoring—one authentic moment at a time.

programme.title: New Zealand From Above
programme.desc: An aerial journey over New Zealand from the deep south of the South Island to the northern tip of the North Island. We discover the landscapes and meet New Zealanders who talk about their work, interests, and culture.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode of Authentic Escapes, host Sandra McLemore uncovers the heart and soul of Budapest, Hungary’s enchanting capital. From panoramic views at Fisherman’s Bastion to the colorful stalls of Central Market Hall, she explores the city’s rich blend of history, food, and culture. Sandra soaks in centuries of tradition at the famous Gellért Thermal Baths, where locals come daily to relax in mineral-rich waters. She then dines at the legendary Gundel Restaurant, where Hungarian staples like goulash and Gundel pancakes are served with royal flair and historical significance. Between bites and baths, Sandra shares practical travel tips—how to ride the tram, when to cross the Danube for the best sunset views, and why you should book Parliament tickets in advance. Whether you're drawn to architecture, cuisine, or unforgettable experiences, this episode proves that Budapest is a city worth savoring—one authentic moment at a time.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode, Sandra McLemore invites you to experience Austria like never before—through its royal palaces, charming villages, and centuries-old traditions. Wander through Schönbrunn Palace after hours, uncovering secret passageways, regal ballrooms, and stories of Empress Sisi. Then, watch a master pastry chef craft the perfect apple strudel—Vienna’s most iconic dessert. The journey continues to Dürnstein, a fairytale village in the Wachau Valley, where apricot orchards, wine, and UNESCO charm steal the spotlight. And in Hallstatt, go underground for an epic adventure through the world’s oldest working salt mine—slides, miner’s gear, and all. Along the way, Sandra shares must-know travel tips for making the most of your Austrian escape. From imperial elegance to alpine thrills, this episode blends history, culture, and flavor into one unforgettable journey.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Throughout the journey, one sacred element has remained constant—Mambe, a traditional preparation of coca leaf that lies at the heart of Indigenous Amazonian life. In this episode, Jeff meets “Happy,” a spirited local who guides him through the complete Mambe-making process, from leaf to ritual. Through the voices of elders and community members, the episode explores the cultural, spiritual, and communal importance of Mambe—revealing its role not just as a sacred tradition, but as a living symbol of identity, respect, and connection to the land.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with some adrenaline pumping sea karting on the West Coast of the Island. He then heads to the home of Manuella to have an Otentik Creole experience with her and her family. A mix of African and European cuisines influenced by Asia, Creole cuisine is a delicious, colorful melting pot of flavours and Manuella teaches Brent just how to blend these notes to create a unique dish. Tasty creole food and too much rum later Brent is having a ball. The next morning Brent hits the markets to get his ingredients for his creole inspired dish. Heading back to the Ravenala hotel he has a refresher before cooking up his own creole creation on the Riviera Riverside.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Host Chef Phillip Davenport asks why so very few people outside of Malaysia ever discuss, let alone praise its fine dining venues so we begin by providing the evidence that the Capital city Kuala Lumpur has the fine dining credentials and an ever growing list of culinary geniuses.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil delves into the KL city's suburban and modern mall food culture. His theory is that a measure of a cities culinary excellence is how good the suburban restaurants are.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Amid the leafy enclosure of KL suburbia lies a piece of exotic Ceylon, namely Aliyaa Restaurant and Bar and its where Chef Phil discovers exec Chef Pradeep specialising in his signature dry cooked curries.This is what fine dining Sri Lankan cuisine is all about.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Isadora Chai is a chef who was a scientist so experimentation is what she thrives on and when she opens her mouth this chef can swear like Gordon Ramsay and invariably does. A fun episode

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: A beautiful tropical island, two world class restaurants and two great Chefs ,Chef Phil and his old friend Chef Richard. They take us on a culinary tour de force presenting some intriguing western recipes and a range delicious modern Langkawi/Malaysia fare.This is a recipe intense episode with plenty to see and learn.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil arrives at the Imperial Sheraton, home of the Celestial Court and his base while he uncovers the enormous culinary exercise that takes place every day here. We begin the Celestial Court where the decisions on what to cook are tough but we end up with classic crispy skinned Roast Duck, Di Sum and a Wok fried Chilli Tempe thats a world beater.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This place rocks and it does in a very Argentinian way.The best meat cooked to perfection is what we see and learn how to achieve. At Pampas meat is what they are all about and Chef Phil discovers thats why the place is packed out every night.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This is an episode dedicated to decadence. Sit back, relax and salivate. Chef Phil and Chef Gaeton take us through the intracacies of making a modern boulliabase from scratch. It is an art. As well we will learn what herbs and spices it takes to lift any gin to levels heavenly.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: We are nearly 60 stories up looking over super KL modern city with the twin towers in our face. This is Italian high end cuisine cooked by owner/chef Modesto Marini himself. We see him with Chef Phil in the working kitchen cooking some Marini signatures and later at the bar delving into some mysterious cocktails.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This Venue is quite simply downright impressive and the big question to come was will the kitchen produce a match for where it will be presented. We see Chef Phil work his way through the decadent degustation then migrate to the kitchen to learn about the preparation.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Another extraordinarily extravagant venue in the centre of the KL Culinary universe. Marble 8 is like a club for the rich and famous in New York or Hollywood and from from what Chef eats, drinks and cooks it could as well be.This is a lavish treat from the walk through the steak aging vault to the flaming crepe suzette prepared at the table.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Yet another culinary gem in the suburbs of KL.This is real Italian with an intense Abruzzian Italian at the helm. Chef Stefano is young and like most great Italian chefs Stefano’s inspiration came from his mothers cooking.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick travel to the coal regions of PA and experience fantastic food and outdoor adventure. They eat ups and downs, go off-roading, roll 1800 feet into the side of a mountain and learn all about making pierogies and kielbasy.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo deja a Katiuska y se va de su casa. Celia regresa a su hogar en estado grave, mientras Manuela busca a su hermana Cecilia para que se reconcilien.
