programme.desc: Hace un año, Jessica confesó haber sacudido violentamente a su bebé y haberle causado graves lesiones cerebrales. Pero ahora se ha retractado y afirma que un vaso con boquilla le causó las lesiones. ¡Sintoniza la transmisión para saber la verdad!

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Terry es acusado de abusar de la hija de Angie. La niña está con su padre Larry y su esposa Angela, decididos a lograr justicia. ¿Podrá Steve revelar la verdad?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Cuando la gente normal necesita ayuda, Steve Wilkos está listo para responder a la llamada. Mira cómo Steve ayuda a la gente normal a defenderse y a luchar por sus creencias para promover la justicia para todos.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Chrishon niega estar comprometido con Taiwana a tres semanas de su boda. ¡Lauren se enfrenta a su ex por dejarla por otra mujer mientras está embarazada! Dave todavía quiere que Leesa lo ame.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Destiny confronta a su amiga por invadir la propiedad de otras personas; una confesión de proporciones épicas podría ser un factor decisivo; un secreto oculto puede alterar los planes de una pareja.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: En el Show de Jerry Springer de hoy, una batalla de novias. Nicole le da un ultimátum a su amante: o la dejas o me pierdes. ¡Jerry ve cómo saltan chispas en el programa de hoy!

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: El marido de Darleen dice que es adicto a los clubes de striptease; el novio de Mary está obsesionado con limpiar su coche, y ella sospecha que lo está usando como tapadera para algo más; el miedo de Jesse al compromiso lo mete en problemas.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: ¡Amigos y familiares se niegan a aceptar el matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo! Martin no quiere que su hijo se case con su novio. April quiere recuperar a su ex, ¡pero está enamorado de un hombre! ¿Quién tiene la última palabra?

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, los feminicidios aumentan alarmantemente. Leidy Johana Hernández, víctima de su pareja Nelson Arturo, sufrió años de abuso. A pesar de las advertencias de sus padres, Leidy no escapó. Su cuerpo fue hallado en su casa. La historia revela la urgencia de intervención y denuncia para prevenir tragedias.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En 2004, en la ciudad de Cali, Diana Herrera murió y fue sepultada en el cementerio Metropolitano de la Arquidiócesis de Cali con un contrato de arrendamiento.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Diana Ospina es contratada como administradora en dos conjuntos en Madrid, Cundinamarca, pero es acusada de desfalco por más de 300 millones de pesos. William López, administrador en Bogotá, también enfrenta denuncias por hurto y estafa. Las investigaciones avanzan lentamente, mientras los residentes buscan justicia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Gregorio es atracado en Bogotá sin recibir ayuda. Séptimo Día realiza un experimento social con actores para observar reacciones ante robos. Las respuestas varían entre ayuda y miedo. El sociólogo Carlos Charry analiza la falta de empatía y solidaridad. Las autoridades insisten en que deben ser ellas quienes actúen, no los ciudadanos.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En un país donde las motos son el corazón del transporte rural, tragedias silenciosas desgarran familias enteras. Cifras alarmantes reflejan la necesidad urgente de conciencia y firmeza en normas de tránsito.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Dos niños mueren luego de ser sedados para procedimientos dentales y las familias exigen respuestas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2012, en La Virginia, Risaralda, Angie Xiomara, una niña de 9 años, desapareció mientras estaba al cuidado de su tío, Víctor Alfonso Cardona. Días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en un cañaduzal. Testigos y evidencias llevaron a la captura de Cardona, quien confesó el crimen. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento contra su sobrina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Valentina Mugno, de 14 años, fue hallada asesinada en su casa en Valledupar en 2011, tras quedar sola una noche. La investigación inicial involucró falsamente a un amigo y a su hermana antes de identificar a Víctor Alfonso Márquez como sospechoso. Una segunda víctima que logró sobrevivir un ataque similar fue clave para el caso. Casi seis años después, Márquez fue condenado a 44 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2009, Ángela María Mejía confesó matar a su esposo Edilson Guzmán. Sus amigos Pedro y Yolanda la encubrieron, pero Yolanda luego descubrió que Pedro era amante de Ángela y la delató. Ángela fue capturada por homicidio y otros delitos.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Cajamarca, Tolima, el líder ambientalista César García fue asesinado frente a su familia tras oponerse a la minera AngloGold Ashanti. Aunque se sospechó de un vínculo con la empresa, las autoridades lo descartaron. Una carta de suicidio reveló que el verdadero autor fue Álvaro Meléndez, vecino con quien García tuvo un litigio de tierras. Meléndez permanece detenido esperando juicio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Andrés Felipe Fierro, joven ingeniero ambiental, fue asesinado en 'Charco Azul', Florencia, Caquetá. La investigación reveló que Rocío Quintero, su amante, y Jarol Villegas, esposo de ella, estuvieron involucrados en el crimen. Un testigo clave confirmó las sospechas. Jarol confesó ser el autor intelectual y fue condenado a 32 años de prisión. Rocío permanece prófuga, rehaciendo su vida en Argentina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2016, en la Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, dos hermanos desaparecieron cerca de la vereda Nuevo Mundo. Tras sospechar inicialmente de la madre, la investigación reveló que David Barbosa Arrieta, empleado de confianza del padre, había abusado y asesinado a los menores. Las pruebas recopiladas confirmaron su culpabilidad, y Barbosa fue condenado a 60 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2016, en Socorro, Santander, Yesenia Bernal fue asesinada para robarle a su bebé recién nacido. Su amiga Edilsa María Díaz, tras perder su propio embarazo y temiendo perder a su pareja, fingió estar embarazada y planeó el crimen junto a Juan Carlos Vega para apropiarse de la niña. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados: Edilsa a 35 años y Juan Carlos a una pena similar.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michelle está demandando a Michael y Nuri por negligencia y pérdida comercial después de que su spa de alta gama se dañó cuando los lechones de Michael y Nuri fueron liberados y se volvieron locos en su negocio.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Los Wilson demandan a Sean Moore, patrocinador de Ballpark Bandits, por 10.000 dólares. Su hijo fue despedido a mitad de temporada, Sean culpa al comportamiento errático de Kevin y a Laurie por fomentar la negatividad e intimidar a los padres.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Adriana y Laura, mujeres que eligieron la maternidad subrogada en Colombia, enfrentan críticas y regulaciones. Hilda Niño, exfiscal, vive bajo custodia tras denunciar corrupción. Duván, bailarín caleño, supera adversidades y triunfa en el arte.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Niños migrantes venezolanos cruzan la frontera hacia Colombia en busca de un futuro mejor, enfrentando hambre, violencia y explotación en "La Arrocera". Historias como la de Evelin, de 14 años, revelan abuso y sufrimiento extremo en su búsqueda de una vida digna, mientras otros, como Ana, sobreviven reciclando en condiciones precarias, aferrados a la esperanza en medio de la adversidad.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Darius ya hizo una prueba de ADN, pero Timisha cree que estaba contaminada. Brittney, con 4 meses de embarazo, exige que Bruce admita ser el padre. Más tarde, ¿Caitlin tuvo el bebé de Eric?

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: ¡Charisma sospecha que Trey la engaña con su prima! ¿Dustin también es infiel con ayuda de su padre? Luego, Greg admite que le atraen las mujeres corpulentas, y Jessica teme que sea un fetiche… ¿o una traición familiar?

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Ebony jura que Andre es el padre de su hija, quien tiene necesidades especiales, ¡pero él lo niega! ¡Luego, Jodi niega rotundamente que sea el padre del bebé de Ashawnda! ¿Qué dirán los resultados de la prueba de ADN?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: El 27 de abril de 2011, un tornado azotó Tuscaloosa, Alabama, causando daños masivos y víctimas. La hija de Toye, Latoya, fue reportada como desaparecida, pero la policía la investigó como homicidio. ¿Tuvo Toye algo que ver con su desaparición?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Sheroya tiene 17 años y se esfuerza por criar a 2 niños mientras sale de fiesta sin parar. Su novio Malcolm suele ser infiel y la maltrata verbalmente. Steve tiene mucho trabajo por delante con esta pareja, pero ¿alguno de ellos despertará?

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Las strippers Precious y Jewels tienen demasiado en común; John descubre que su amigo es responsable de la crisis de su matrimonio; la novia de DJ quiere ver a otras personas.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Un hombre transgénero tiene dudas sobre casarse con una mujer; Germaine quiere que su ex lo acepte de nuevo y revela un secreto; el marido de Stormie le da un ultimátum.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Kiki y Kat eran compañeras de trabajo que se enamoraron. ¡Pero ahora Kat dejará a Kiki por un hombre! Después, Cedric viene a decirle a su novia que quiere llevar su relación a otro nivel... y a otra persona.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Chyna se enfrenta a su "amiga" traicionera; Jarod dice que el estrés de ser el único sostén de su familia lo ha llevado por el camino del adulterio; Derrick le propone matrimonio a su exnovia, que ya está casada.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Paige desaprueba al novio de su hermana y diseña un plan para que lo deje; otra mujer puede frustrar los planes de Derek de hacer de su novia una parte permanente de su vida; Tony quiere a la novia de su primo.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Alex afirma que lo forzaron a estar con su novia y guarda un secreto; dos mujeres pelean en puré de manzana por Lexi; Tai dejó Atlanta por Ohio para estar con la mamá de su bebé, pero tiene una confesión.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Ha habido un aumento en los ataques contra la policía y los delincuentes muestran menos miedo a la autoridad.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Ana Lucía quiere justicia luego de que su padre la dejara embarazada a los 14 años y nunca fue a la cárcel.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Sueños de éxito transformados en pesadillas. Inversiones millonarias en franquicias prometedoras que se desmoronan bajo la corrupción y las mentiras. Desde jardines infantiles hasta centros de estética, historias de fraude y desesperación emergen.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En el hospital El Salvador de Ubaté, muertes de bebés por negligencia médica se acumulan entre 2022 y 2023. Padres denuncian diagnósticos erróneos y falta de insumos. La Gerente, ya señalada en un caso anterior, es el blanco de las acusaciones.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Tres hombres, acusados injustamente de abusos, luchan por su libertad tras años de cárcel y sufrimiento. A pesar de pruebas que demuestran su inocencia, la verdad tardó demasiado en salir a la luz. ¿Quién paga por el daño de una falsa denuncia?

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Cali, vecinos del barrio La Independencia tomaron justicia por mano propia tras el robo a Sara Ortega. Cansados de la impunidad, golpearon al ladrón, Jaime Barona López, con antecedentes desde 2002. La comunidad, frustrada por la inseguridad, busca soluciones ante la falta de acción judicial.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Ana Rosa García, venezolana de 24 años, fue hallada muerta el 7 de julio de 2020 en Inírida. Su ex, Alexander Matiz, obsesionado con ella, fue identificado por registros telefónicos y capturado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Luz Karime Parada, una joven y humilde campesina quien al parecer sostenía un romance con el hermano de su esposo. Un día, la joven en estado de embarazo desapareció y sólo un año después autoridades hallan el cuerpo enterrado en la casa de sus cuñados. Según declaraciones de familiares y conocidos la investigación apuntaba a un crimen netamente pasional.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Armenia, un niño de 6 años fue hallado sin vida en el río Quindío. La investigación inicial sospechó de sus padres y de Jhony, mayordomo de una finca cercano a la madre, Liliana. Evidencias reconstructivas señalaron a Jhony como el principal sospechoso. En el juicio, confesó su participación y reveló que su jefe fue cómplice y autor directo del crimen. Jhony fue condenado a 40 años, pero su jefe fue absuelto por falta de pruebas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El veintiuno (21) de abril de dos mil once (2011) en Caicedonia (Valle) ocurre el atroz asesinato de Jenifer Hoyos una niña de nueve (9) años a manos de Yeison Leandro Ortiz un amigo de la familia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Chinchiná, Caldas, en 2012, Angie, de 14 años, desapareció tras aceptar en secreto una cita con un hombre que le prometió un celular. Ocho días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en la vereda "La Pola". La verdad salió a la luz cuando Javier, un preso en Popayán, acusó a su propio hermano del asesinato de la menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Soacha, Doris Góngora y su hija de 8 años fueron halladas asesinadas en su vivienda. Evidencia de sangre, huellas y registros telefónicos llevaron a los investigadores hasta Jorge Antonio Trujillo, sobrino de Doris. A pesar de negar los cargos, las pruebas forenses lo vincularon directamente con el doble crimen. Fue condenado a 60 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y hurto calificado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En una vereda de Cimitarra, Santander, Pedro Suta se obsesiona con Irene, esposa de su jefe Arcilio. Tras ser rechazado, la asesina junto a su hijo menor, decapitándola y desmembrando al niño. Ese día, Arcilio estaba de viaje con otro hijo por un tratamiento médico. Al descubrirse las desapariciones, la comunidad se alerta e inicia una intensa búsqueda para dar con el responsable del doble homicidio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2015, en Caquetá, cuatro niños fueron brutalmente asesinados en su casa. Pablo, el único sobreviviente, ayudó a resolver el caso años después. La investigación reveló que Luz Mila, en disputa por tierras con la familia Vanegas, contrató a Christopher Chávez, alias "El Desalmado", y su cómplice "Chencho" para cometer el crimen. Luz Mila fue condenada a cadena perpetua, Chávez a 40 años, y "Chencho" a 20 años.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Gabriella está demandando a su ex empleadora, Jaqueline Mendoza, por $600,000 por angustia mental y despido injustificado luego de sufrir un ataque de pánico durante una celebración de la empresa.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Barbara demanda al club de striptease de Emilio por 30.000 dólares, alegando negligencia y angustia emocional. Ella afirma haber sufrido un latigazo cervical por la actuación de Jackson y una silla que se derrumbó. Emilio niega su responsabilidad, citando la seguridad y el consumo de alcohol de Bárbara.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Carlos Andrés Montoya, suboficial del ejército, perdió la vista en 2010 tras un ataque de las FARC mientras buscaba cercar al 'Mono Jojoy' en la Sierra de la Macarena. Diez años después, sigue activo en el ejército y se convirtió en psicólogo. Junto a Los Informantes, revive el lugar donde todo ocurrió, semanas antes de que Jojoy fuera abatido en la Operación Sodoma.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: En los cementerios de Bogotá opera un cartel que soborna vigilantes, policías y sepultureros para robar cadáveres y revender bóvedas varias veces. Carlos, un profanador de tumbas, revela cómo extrae y vende huesos y dientes a universidades y clínicas, ganando millones por noche. Notarías falsifican escrituras, dejando a familias como la de Jaime Molina víctimas de un fraude macabro y sistemático.

programme.title: Maury
programme.desc: Raymisha y Tianca tienen hijos con un hombre llamado Robert. ¡Pero Robert niega ser el padre! ¡Estas mujeres quieren que asuma el rol! Más tarde, Ashley cometió un error y ahora teme que su familia quede destrozada para siempre.

programme.title: Equipo De Investigacion
programme.desc: La Cienciología, la religión de las estrellas. Su cara más visible es Tom Cruise. Desde que el actor inaugurara su centro más importante en Madrid, se ha extendido por muchas capitales españolas

programme.title: El Colegio Invisible

programme.desc: La detención en Madrid de Cabeza de cerdo, uno de los mayores traficantes de mujeres del mundo, condenado a 30 años de cárcel en 2012, ha desatado una guerra entre varias organizaciones criminales.

programme.title: Policías en Acción
programme.desc: Cada año se producen en España cerca de 300 atracos a bancos y cajas. Policías en acción muestra la historia de dos hombres que asaltan una entidad bancaria en el centro de Palma de Mallorca.

programme.desc: Las redes de prostitución africanas cuentan con una pieza importante en su engranaje delictivo. Son las conocidas como Mamis, mujeres encargadas de controlar con mano de hierro a las jóvenes.

programme.desc: Alejandra Andrade busca a la única española testigo de la guerra que los ciudadanos le han declarado a los narcos.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation

programme.title: Winchester Life

In this episode we’ll tag along with Melissa while she chases big game around the world with her Winchester in hand. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Shotgun sports are experiencing unprecedented growth, with competitions across the country gaining popularity as enthusiasts vie to be the best shooters in the world. Every summer, the Amateur Trapshooting Association hosts The Grand American in Sparta, Illinois. This year marks the 125th Anniversary for the largest trap shooting competition in the world. We’ll talk with the people who make this tournament run behind the scenes and explore what makes this tournament such a special event. We’ll also look at the rich history of The Grand. On-site we’ll chat with the curator of the Trapshooting Hall of Fame and look at some of the incredible historical pieces on display in the museum. Additionally, we’ll learn about White Flyer and how the clay manufacturer has made important innovations for the shotgun sports.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.desc: An Evening Of Nostalgia with Annie Lennox captures one of music's most popular and acclaimed artists in her only full concert performance of songs from her Grammy-nominated Nostalgia album.

programme.title: James Taylor - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas; the festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Maroon 5 -- Live in London 2014
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this Maroon 5 concert features songs such as "Moves Like Jagger," "Daylight," "This Love" and many more.

programme.title: The 1975: Rock Am Ring 2019
programme.desc: Rock im Park is a music festival that takes place in Nuremberg, Germany, lasting three days; featuring: The 1975.

programme.title: BLACKPINK - The Show
programme.desc: The Show opened with Kill This Love, following a video featuring sights of dark and empty cities around the world.[9] Apart from live performances it also included several pre-recorded tracks.

programme.title: Genesis: Sum of the Parts
programme.desc: The history of the British rock group Genesis includes members Phil Collins, Peter Gabriel, Tony Banks, Mike Rutherford, Steve Hackett and Anthony Phillips.

programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live
programme.desc: This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance the album Days of Future Passed.

programme.title: The Clash - Rebel Truce: The history of The Clash
programme.desc: The Clash were one of the most influential bands to blow up from the Punk rock scene of 1977, with the late Joe Strummer revered as one of the greatest frontmen in rock'n'Roll music history.

programme.title: Alabama & Friends - Live at the Ryman
programme.desc: Join superstar band Alabama, recorded at the historic Ryman Auditorium, featuring on stage collaborations with country's biggest stars: Luke Bryan, Jason Aldean, Trisha Yearwood, Florida Georgia Line, Jamey Johnson and the Eli Young Band.

programme.title: Electric Light Orchestra - Live at Wembley 1978
programme.desc: Captured live at London's Wembley Arena and directed by Mike Mansfield this space-age show will live forever in rock history as, quite literally, out of this world.

programme.title: Elvis Costello & The Imposters - Live In Memphis
programme.desc: During this concert of September 2004, Costello performs live a selection of his greatest hits including 'Peace, Love and Understanding', 'Alison', 'The Delivery Man', 'Pump It Up'... as well as tracks from his latest album.

programme.title: Journey - Live in Manila
programme.desc: On March 14, 2009, Journey returned to Arnel Pineda's homeland and introduced him as their newest lead singer to a crowd of nearly 30,000 at the SM Mall of Asia Concert Grounds. Features songs such as Don't Stop Believin', Stone In Love, When You Love A Woman and Separate Ways.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the Circus Krone in Munich, this concert features performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next to the Moon" and more.

programme.title: The Offspring: Rock AM
programme.desc: The Offspring is an American rock band from California; originally formed under the name Manic Subsidal, the band's lineup consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Dexter Holland, bassist Todd Morse and lead guitarist Kevin Wasserman.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Gwen Stefani - This is What The Truth Feels Like Tour 2016
programme.desc: This is What The Truth Feels Like is a Gwen Stefani tour made to publicize her album, with the same name. The tour was done in the United States and Canada in 2016.

programme.title: Grace Mitchell - Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Tony Bennett - Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: The hits from Duets II are beautifully recorded on the videos of studio recordings, Duets II - The Great Performances. Starring Andrea Bocelli, Michael Bublé, Natalie Cole, Sheryl Crow, Aretha Franklin, Josh Groban, Faith Hill, Norah Jones, and more.

programme.title: Alice in Chains - Unplugged
programme.desc: In their first live concert in over 2 years (and possibly their last concert ever), Alternative/metal group Alice in Chains performs acoustically at MTV Unplugged. Includes acoustic versions of their hits.

programme.title: Yes - Songs From Tsongas 35th Anniversary
programme.desc: Songs From Tsongas is a live performance from Yes' 35th Anniversary Tour in 2004, the last tour by the band to feature the classic line-up of Jon Anderson, Steve Howe, Chris Squire, Rick Wakeman and Alan White.

programme.title: Jethro Tull - Live at Montreux, 2003
programme.desc: Split into a semi-acoustic first half and a full on electric second half, the concert was a triumph combining newer songs such as Dot Com, Pavane and Budapest with classic favorites. programme.title: Don't Go Gentle: A Film About IDLES
programme.desc: Don’t Go Gentle chronicles the rise of British punk band IDLES, exploring how a group of friends from Bristol transformed pain and vulnerability into creative power. Through candid interviews, raw live performances, and emotional moments, the film captures the band’s journey from small clubs to international acclaim.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sam Carter, the powerhouse vocalist of Architects, for a candid conversation about gut instincts, creative integrity, and nearly two decades of building one of heavy music’s most influential bands. Sam opens up about his serendipitous bond with Good Charlotte, the “say yes or say no” mindset that guides his decisions, and how gratitude—and a little British self-deprecation—keep him grounded. He reflects on Warped Tour dreams turned stadium reality, the band’s tight-knit dynamic, and why this era is about smiling more, having fun, and bringing the wide-eyed 13-year-old version of himself back on stage. They also talk about Architects’ new album, The Sky, The Earth & All Between (out Feb 28), aiming to make their 11th record their biggest and most honest yet.

programme.title: Hey Violet: The Final Show (Live from Los Angeles)
programme.desc: Recorded live in Los Angeles, this farewell concert captures Hey Violet’s final performance together after nine years as a band. Featuring raw emotion, high energy, and fan-favorite songs, the show is a powerful celebration of their evolution from pop-punk newcomers to alternative mainstays.

programme.title: Believer

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Bobby from the British punk-rap duo Bob Vylan joins Joel Madden for an unfiltered conversation about self-determination, identity, and breaking barriers in music. Bobby opens up about growing up between London and Ipswich, navigating racism, finding purpose through education, and how his lived experiences fuel the band’s powerful, socially charged sound.

programme.title: Rascal Flatts: Life Is a Highway Tour: Live from Columbus
programme.desc: Country superstars Rascal Flatts celebrate 25 years of music with a hometown performance in Columbus, Ohio, recorded on their Life Is a Highway Tour. The set features timeless hits like Bless the Broken Road, What Hurts the Most, Mayberry, Fast Cars and Freedom, and Life Is a Highway. It’s an evening filled with nostalgia, gratitude, and classic country harmony.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy starts to worry her whims might have consequences and brings in a scientist and a theologist to unpack chaos theory, the butterfly effect, and free will—while she processes the futility of it all. A game-show parody (“Lucky Case Game”) goes off the rails, the house band Rodent’s Revenge keeps the chaos moving, and Poppy “liberates” her beloved plants with the gift of free will. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Gottmik / Mayer Hawthorne: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Gottmik launches a beauty brand, while Mayer Hawthorne shares his wine and vinyl-inspired business journey.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Actor and writer O’Shea Jackson Jr. joins Joel Madden for an insightful conversation about Hollywood’s misconceptions, family legacy, and creative purpose. Jackson discusses balancing fame with authenticity, lessons from his upbringing, the importance of privacy in the digital age, and how writing became a core outlet for his creativity.

programme.title: MisterWives: The Don’t Look Down Tour: Live from The Wiltern
programme.desc: Indie-pop band MisterWives close out The Don’t Look Down Tour with an electrifying, sold-out performance at The Wiltern in Los Angeles. Fronted by Mandy Lee, the group performs a dynamic mix of hits and new songs from their album Nosebleeds, blending soaring vocals, raw emotion, and vibrant stage energy. The night captures the band’s message of resilience, growth, and celebration as they connect with fans in a transformative live experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Tim McIlrath of Rise Against to discuss the real-world impact of music, risks that comes with standing by your convictions on stage, the vulnerability of putting your flaws into every song, and what's coming next for the band, with two new songs on the way.

programme.title: Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls: The First Four Albums (2012 Revisited) Live in Anaheim
programme.desc: Night 2 of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim finds Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls tearing through favorites and deep cuts from the first four albums—Sleep Is for the Week, Love Ire & Song, Poetry of the Deed, and England Keep My Bones. A charged, communal set featuring sing-alongs like “Try This at Home,” “Reasons Not to Be an Idiot,” “Nashville Tennessee,” “Peggy Sang the Blues,” “There Is No God,” and “If Ever I Stray/Keep Having Dreams,” captured live at House of Blues Anaheim.

programme.title: An Evening With Becky Lucas
programme.desc: Becky Lucas delivers a candid stand-up set with sharp, self-deprecating humor, sharing personal stories and punchlines from her early material with wit and honesty.

programme.title: Ice Nine Kills: I Heard They Kill Live 2
programme.desc: Watch I Heard They Kill Live 2, a live Ice Nine Kills concert film captured at Thanx-killing 2022 in Massachusetts.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 4 – Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls close out Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim with a sold-out, career-spanning set packed with fan favorites, sing-alongs and candid moments. Highlights include “1933,” “Recovery,” “The Next Storm,” “Miranda” and “Little Changes,” capping four nights of music and celebration.

programme.title: Kansas: Miracles out of Nowhere
programme.desc: A 2015 full-length documentary film tells the untold story of a successful American rock band. In-depth interviews with all 6 original members recount their rise.

programme.title: Foxing: Live at The Grandel
programme.desc: Foxing performs Draw Down The Moon in full, captured live at The Grandel in St. Louis for a concert film experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Dasha. Born in San Luis Obispo, California, Dasha started performing at ten and released her first song at thirteen. After years as an independent artist, her 2023 single "Austin (Boots Stop Workin')" went viral and landed her a deal with Warner Records. Since then, she's made her Grand Ole Opry debut, joined the Spotify Billions Club, and toured with Thomas Rhett and Luke Bryan.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Host Joel Madden talks with Jesse Leach, vocalist of Killswitch Engage, about the band’s legacy, mental health, and rediscovering balance after years on the road. Leach reflects on growing up in a religious home, finding community through punk and hardcore, and building a life grounded in creativity and purpose.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Country-rock singer-songwriter HARDY joins Joel Madden to talk about bridging the worlds of rock and country, evolving from songwriter to artist, and why connecting with fans matters most. They swap stories about small-town roots, creative identity, and finding value in authenticity over fame.

programme.title: Elevation Worship and Steven Furtick: Elevation Nights Live from Philadelphia
programme.desc: Elevation Worship and Steven Furtick perform the final stop of Elevation Nights 2024 in Philadelphia with a powerful live worship experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Magnolia Park frontman Joshua Roberts joins Joel Madden for a heartfelt conversation about anime, identity, and carving out space in rock music. Joshua reflects on navigating racism in the scene, channeling emotion into art, and leading Magnolia Park’s creative community with resilience and purpose. From social media strategy to self-belief, this episode dives deep into what it means to stay authentic while inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: Carole King: Welcome to My Living Room
programme.desc: Carole King performs an intimate 2005 concert in Southern California, featuring 21 Top 40 hits from her legendary career.

programme.title: Judas Priest: Epitaph
programme.desc: Judas Priest performs a powerful final tour set at Hammersmith Apollo, featuring songs spanning their 40-year career.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: In this surreal premiere, Poppy hits the streets of Monrovia offering eerie fortunes, interviews a survivor of the Dave Matthews Band bus disaster, and encounters Archduke Franz Ferdinand in a time-warping twist. Between absurd sketches and existential reflections, she performs a musical lesson on embracing chaos and taking risks. TV-14 (fictional violence, language).

programme.title: 10 Years of Noise and Confusion: Oasis Live at Barrowlands
programme.desc: Filmed live at Glasgow’s Barrowlands, Oasis performs Supersonic, Roll With It, and more in a “back to the roots” anniversary show capturing their raw live energy.

programme.title: Megadeth - Crush The World Tour Live from Buenos Aires – Night 1
programme.desc: Megadeth kicks off a two-night stand at Buenos Aires’ Movistar Arena on the Crush The World Tour. Filmed for Veeps, Night 1 delivers a blistering set of thrash classics and newer tracks, led by Dave Mustaine and fueled by the crowd’s relentless energy.

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts Part 2
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live In Hamburg
programme.desc: Ein legendärer Auftritt einer Hardrock-Legende in Hamburg! Diese Aufnahme vereint frisches Material mit zeitlosen Klassikern. Eine musikalische Reise durch mehr als dreißig Jahre Rockgeschichte, die pure Energie und Nostalgie verspricht.

programme.title: From The Scene For The Scene
programme.desc: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.

programme.title: Black Metal Ceremony
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Power Metal Journey
programme.desc: Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy.

programme.title: Faure's Requiem
programme.desc: Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.

programme.title: The Four Seasons

programme.title: Mahler: Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra.

programme.title: Works for Lute by J. S. Bach
